name: The Detective
description: An aspect of Jace who guided the planeswalkers through his mindscape.

description_citations.text: "Vraska". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In a lecture hall they find the number of beings in the Multiverse on a chalkboard and meet the Detective, an aberration of Jace.
timeline.quote: Jace steps through, but not the one from upstairs.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 6: The Man Who Kills His Own Ambition
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 6: The Man Who Kills His Own Ambition" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: The Detective explains that the body is connected to the illusion and proposes that killing the body will stall the overlay, and that they need the Soldier.
timeline.quote: We'll need to find him. Then we'll have a chance to finish the task and eliminate the body.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 6: The Man Who Kills His Own Ambition
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 6: The Man Who Kills His Own Ambition" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: The Detective apologizes to Vraska, saying he loved all of them, and Vraska embraces him, saying we are who we choose to be.
timeline.quote: "You are no monster," she says with gritted teeth. "We are who we choose to be."

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 6: The Man Who Kills His Own Ambition
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 6: The Man Who Kills His Own Ambition" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: The Detective says he chooses to be the man who kills his own ambition, and Vraska kisses him.
timeline.quote: "I choose to be the man who kills his own ambition."

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 6: The Man Who Kills His Own Ambition
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 6: The Man Who Kills His Own Ambition" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Vraska realizes that for the spell to slow, Jace's body must die.
timeline.quote: Vraska, lip trembling, finishes her conclusion. "You need to die."

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 6: The Man Who Kills His Own Ambition
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 6: The Man Who Kills His Own Ambition" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: The Detective tells Vraska the Theorist must be stopped and that he must die; Vraska objects.
timeline.quote: The Theorist must be stopped , he says in her mind. I must die.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 7: Pick Up the Pieces
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 7: Pick Up the Pieces" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: The Detective explains that the spell destroying a Multiverse depends on their body being alive, so removing it is the only way.
timeline.quote: "Because the spell that is about to annihilate an entire Multiverse is contingent on our body being alive," says the Detective.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 7: Pick Up the Pieces
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 7: Pick Up the Pieces" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Vraska tearfully shares her grief about losing him and the fear of forgetting; the Detective says she would betray him only if she never changed.
timeline.quote: Then you'd kill me a third time."

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 7: Pick Up the Pieces
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 7: Pick Up the Pieces" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: The Detective asks the others to find the rest of his parts and hold them in their minds until they can be unified with the Theorist's body.
timeline.quote: You'll need to find the rest of me.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 7: Pick Up the Pieces
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 7: Pick Up the Pieces" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Chandra rages against the plan and compares it to Gideon's death, but the Detective calls his death atonement; Chandra hugs him and they trade farewells.
timeline.quote: "It's not like what Gideon did. It's atonement."

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 7: Pick Up the Pieces
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 7: Pick Up the Pieces" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Ajani pledges support and the Detective vanishes into Vraska's mind in a blue light.
timeline.quote: His body loses form, a steely blue light turns skin to vapor, and in the blink of an eye he is gone.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 7: Pick Up the Pieces
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 7: Pick Up the Pieces" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Vraska and her allies enter a hall of phyresis, with the Detective commenting from inside her mind.
timeline.quote: The sight of phyresis makes Vraska's scars ache.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 7: Pick Up the Pieces
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 7: Pick Up the Pieces" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Vraska scents the true compleated Jace hiding at the back of the room, bleeding oil and pulling a sword from his chest.
timeline.quote: is the true compleated Jace, huddled on the ground, pulling a shining sword from his chest.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 7: Pick Up the Pieces
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 7: Pick Up the Pieces" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Vraska takes in the Nihilist, who vanishes into her mind; the Detective reports that he is safe.
timeline.quote: "My turn to save you," she promises

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 7: Pick Up the Pieces
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 7: Pick Up the Pieces" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: They emerge on Zendikar and decide to follow the portals; Garruk senses Eldrazi illusions.
timeline.quote: "Eldrazi are near. More illusions of them, anyway."

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 7: Pick Up the Pieces
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 7: Pick Up the Pieces" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Vraska plans to be launched by Chandra's explosion to petrify her double, guided by the aberrations in her mind.
timeline.quote: "You're going to launch me high enough that I can petrify my double."

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 9: Unafraid
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 9: Unafraid" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: The aberrations rush into the Theorist and overtake his mind, each taking a role in subduing him.
timeline.quote: They overtake his mind like a tsunami.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 9: Unafraid
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 9: Unafraid" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: The Theorist has Vraska, Ajani and Chandra tossed into his mental space where the Detective finds them.
timeline.quote: The Theorist had the Echoverse doubles of the four planeswalkers round them up and toss them through a portal to his mental space

citation.work: Jace Beleren
citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Grand project". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vraska is separated from the others in a memory trap.
timeline.quote: Vraska became entangled in a memory trap and got separated from the others

citation.work: Vraska
citation.text: "Vraska", section "Reality Fracture". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Vraska kisses the Detective, the part of Jace she trusts most.
relations.quote: Without hesitation, she leans forward and kisses him.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 6: The Man Who Kills His Own Ambition
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 6: The Man Who Kills His Own Ambition" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2026.

relations.note: Vraska loves him and grieves at his plan to die.
relations.quote: With allies at her side and her love closer than her heart's vein, she walks through the door.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 7: Pick Up the Pieces
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 7: Pick Up the Pieces" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2026.

pages_say.description: A shackled aberration of Jace in a brown trench coat, the part that sees how it all fits together, who asks Vraska to let him die to stall the Theorist.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 6: The Man Who Kills His Own Ambition
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 6: The Man Who Kills His Own Ambition" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2026.

pages_say.description: The part of Jace that Vraska loves, who proposes a plan to destroy the Theorist's body by uniting all of Jace's parts, which means his own death; he travels inside Vraska's mind.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 7: Pick Up the Pieces
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 7: Pick Up the Pieces" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2026.

pages_say.description: An aberration of Jace who advises Vraska to aim at forty-seven degrees and cuts the Theorist's connection to the weaving.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 9: Unafraid
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 9: Unafraid" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

pages_say.description: A selfless aspect of Jace who helped the planeswalkers plan against the Theorist.
